# Sawari: Hyderabad driving simulator

> Sawari is a free 3D driving simulator that runs in a web browser on phones, tablets, laptops and PCs. It recreates five real Hyderabad (Telangana, India) routes from OpenStreetMap and elevation data, with left-hand traffic, a right-hand-drive car, traffic signals, local traffic (autos, buses, two-wheelers), pedestrians, spoken turn-by-turn directions and a debrief that scores each drive and explains every fault. It is for practice and does not replace driving lessons or the RTA test.

Key facts:
- Name: Sawari (Urdu for "a ride"); tagline "Drive Hyderabad". Website: https://sawari.airacode.online/
- Made by: AiraCode Technologies (https://airacode.online)
- Price: free; no download, no sign-up; plays at https://sawari.airacode.online/play.html
- Devices: phones and tablets (held sideways, on-screen steering wheel and GO/BRAKE pedals), laptops and desktops (keyboard or gamepad)
- Routes (5, 18.8 km in all): Tank Bund Road (1.7 km, easy), Necklace Road (5.0 km, easy), Charminar and Pathergatti (2.1 km, hard), Cyber Towers to Jubilee Hills (7.4 km, medium), Banjara Hills Road No. 1 (2.6 km, medium)
- Car: automatic gearbox with ABS; chase view or driver's seat; morning, midday, evening and night
- Rules checked: speeding, keeping left, wrong way on one-way roads, leaving the road, red lights, collisions, speed breakers taken too fast, turns without an indicator
- Sharing: a score card picture after each drive and a "challenge a friend" link with the score to beat
- Languages: website in English, Hindi, Urdu and Telugu; blog (66 articles) in English
- Data: map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); terrain from open terrain tiles
- Not affiliated with the Telangana Transport Department (RTA) or the traffic police

## Release notes
- [Sawari 1.13.0: busier roads, zebra crossings and cleaner junctions](https://sawari.airacode.online/blog/sawari-1-13-0-release-notes.html): Sawari 1.13.0 adds 50% more traffic at every level, people who cross only on zebra crossings at a red, and junctions with no poles or parked cars in the way.
- [Sawari 1.10.0: eleven new guides, a Hyderabad driving FAQ and glossary](https://sawari.airacode.online/blog/sawari-1-10-0-release-notes.html): Sawari 1.10.0 adds eleven guides, including a Hyderabad driving FAQ with 49 answers and a 60-term glossary, and credits AiraCode Technologies as its maker.
- [Sawari 1.11.0: learning what helps you drive better](https://sawari.airacode.online/blog/sawari-1-11-0-release-notes.html): Sawari 1.11.0 adds privacy-respecting analytics, so we can see which routes are too hard, which phones struggle and which guides help, and improve Sawari.
- [Sawari 1.12.0: send us feedback from inside the game](https://sawari.airacode.online/blog/sawari-1-12-0-release-notes.html): Sawari 1.12.0 adds a Send feedback form to the start page, pause and results screens and the website footer, so you can report bugs or ask for new routes.
- [Sawari 1.8.0: a real engine note, navigation-style directions and smooth slopes](https://sawari.airacode.online/blog/sawari-1-8-0-release-notes.html): Sawari 1.8.0 gives the car an engine that sounds like one, spoken directions like a navigation app, and smooth slopes on every road in all five Hyderabad routes.
- [Sawari 1.9.0: share your score card and challenge your friends](https://sawari.airacode.online/blog/sawari-1-9-0-release-notes.html): Sawari 1.9.0 makes every drive shareable: a score card for WhatsApp status and Instagram Stories, and a link that challenges a friend to beat your score.
